content: cargo-llvm-cov (0.8.7) uses LLVM source-based instrumentation and is the most accurate Rust coverage tool in 2025. Supports line/region/branch coverage; output formats: text, HTML, JSON, LCOV, Cobertura, Codecov. Requires rustc 1.87+ for installation but can run against stable builds; needs llvm-tools-preview component. GitHub Actions: install via taiki-e/install-action@cargo-llvm-cov, run cargo llvm-cov --all-features --workspace --lcov. cargo-tarpaulin is Linux-only x86_64, ptrace-based, less accurate, was superseded; avoid for new projects.
